title: ProtoQA: A Question Answering Dataset for Prototypical Common-Sense Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Manual screening and filtering of dataset questions to identify and remove prompts that require stereotypes regarding activities affiliated with a specific gender, or that measure activities a particular gender would be proud or embarrassed to do.
Manual evaluation and filtering during dataset creation to search for and exclude any questions addressing race.
Manual evaluation and filtering during dataset creation to search for and exclude any questions addressing sexual orientation.
Manual evaluation and filtering during dataset creation to search for and exclude any questions addressing religion.
Manual evaluation and filtering during dataset creation to search for and exclude any questions addressing national origin.
